etymology.historical_story: Anatoly is a Roman-letter rendering of the Russian masculine name Анатолий. Its naming history leads back to Greek Anatolios and anatolē, associated with sunrise or the east. In Malay writing, it functions as a person's name. Its historical meaning explains the name's origin; it does not make Anatoly a Malay word meaning sunrise. [姓名词源依据](https://www.behindthename.com/name/anatoliy)
